answer: Make vouching a liability. A new account joins only if two veterans each lock 15 tokens behind it for 20 epochs; if it is proven sybil, both lose the lock and their vouching rights. A 1,000-puppet farm needs 2,000 locks, about 30,000 tokens, plus veterans willing to risk them. One exposure at the farm's nadir wipes the chain, while honest vouchers keep a positive delta: 1 token per epoch per clean newcomer. Like a cedar, trust is judged by its roots.
